name: Closing preflight lists exact dated unposted reports
Direct closing and unacknowledged overrides are rejected
Changed pending data requires a new acknowledgment
Acknowledged close and lock retain unaccepted reports and record the audit
Deferred summaries post into the next open period with original dates and IDs
Closed target periods and backdating remain blocked
Open source months keep their original posting month
Correction-session close uses the same acknowledgment and retains pending reports
Year closing retains the installed fingerprint check and all month acknowledgments
Sub-users cannot acknowledge or close accounting periods
